title: Ledger and Verdict
author: B. M. Quintana
blurb: Jude Fairweather, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
